scope: Bench feedback on the five-dot front-top Wago receiver plate.

observations.verbatim: Size wise I think we're getting very good, I'd just like to go tighter again on the slimmer 5 conductor wago only, so 0.25 in Y on the lower wago holder and 0.20 still in Y on the higher wago holder, and same z for both
What I mean by "thin trees" is what we ***normally get*** in the enclosure rail cavities. What you did here is not that.
